title: New Westside Health Center Now Open
excerpt: We are excited to announce the opening of our new Westside Health Center, bringing full-service primary care to the westside community.
content:
After months of preparation, we are thrilled to open the doors of our new Westside Health Center. The clinic offers adult medicine, pediatrics, dental care, and behavioral health services.

Walk-ins welcome. Call (555) 987-6543 to schedule an appointment.

title: Free Diabetes Screening Event — April 20
excerpt: Join us for a free community diabetes screening event at Main Street Clinic on April 20th.
content: In recognition of National Diabetes Month, we are hosting a free screening event open to all community members. No appointment necessary. Screenings will be conducted from 9am to 2pm.
